text: Given your history of colon cancer, I need to check if this swelling is related to metastasis or a primary skin/soft tissue lesion. Does the swelling feel hard and fixed to deeper structures, or is it soft and movable under the skin?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Colon cancer (colectomy performed), type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypertension, osteoarthritis of the left knee. Social history: Works as a traffic warden, frequently plays golf.

speaker: Doctor
text: The location on the nape of the neck and your history of golf suggest this might be a cystic lesion. Is the swelling fluctuant (fluid-filled) or firm, and have you noticed any redness or warmth over the area recently?
